name: new-player-check
author: Takaro
description: New Player Check: an anti-cheat check for players who join this server for the first time. It catches cheated or transferred characters: a level above your limit, forbidden items, too many of an item, or a too-full inventory. By default it only alerts admins (in-game PM to players with the alerts permission, plus an optional Discord channel). Per rule you can also kick, ban or give a role such as Flagged. Admins run npcheck <player> to check someone now and npclear <player> to mark them reviewed. Level is checked only when the game reports it; inventory needs a connector that reports inventories.
summary: Anti-cheat check on a player's first join: level above a limit, forbidden items, too many of an item or a too-full inventory. Alerts admins in-game and on Discord by default; per rule it can also kick, ban or give a role. npcheck <player> checks now, npclear <player> marks reviewed. Level is checked only when the game reports it.

maxLevelOnFirstJoin.title: Max level on first join
maxLevelOnFirstJoin.description: Flag a new player whose character level is above this. 0 turns the level check off. Only works when the game reports a level (player progression, or the level command below).

levelTrackKey.title: Level track
levelTrackKey.description: Which progression track is the character level, for games that report several (for example a skill or class key). Empty uses the highest level the game reports.

levelCommand.title: Level console command
levelCommand.description: Optional fallback for games that do not report progression: a console command that prints a player's level. {gameId} is replaced by the player's game ID. Empty means no command is used.

levelPattern.title: Level pattern
levelPattern.description: Regular expression that finds the level in the output of the level command. The first group is the level.

forbiddenItems.title: Forbidden items
forbiddenItems.description: Items a new player should not have. Max amount 0 means any amount is flagged; above 0 flags a player who carries more than that many.

maxTotalItems.title: Max total items
maxTotalItems.description: Flag a new player who carries more items than this in total (all stacks added up). 0 turns this check off.

watchHours.title: Check every join for (hours)
watchHours.description: Also check on every join during this many hours after the first join. 0 checks the first join only.

levelAction.title: Action: level too high
levelAction.description: What happens when the level is above the limit. Admins are always alerted.

itemAction.title: Action: forbidden or too many items
itemAction.description: What happens when a forbidden item, or too many of an item, is found. Admins are always alerted.

totalItemsAction.title: Action: too many items in total
totalItemsAction.description: What happens when the inventory holds more than the max total items. Admins are always alerted.

flagRoleName.title: Flag role name
flagRoleName.description: Name of an existing role given to a player by the role action, for example Flagged. npclear removes it again.

actionReason.title: Kick / ban reason
actionReason.description: Shown to a kicked or banned player.
actionReason.default: Your character did not pass this server's new player check. Contact an admin.

banDuration.title: Ban duration
banDuration.description: How long the ban action bans for. 0 bans permanently.

discordChannelId.title: Discord channel ID
discordChannelId.description: Also post alerts in this Discord channel. Leave empty for in-game alerts only.

permissions.description: Online players with this permission get a PM when a new player fails the check.
Allows npcheck (check a player now) and npclear (mark a player reviewed).
Players with this permission are never checked automatically.

npcheck.description: Run the new player check on a player now
npcheck.helpText: Usage: npcheck <player>. Shows the player's level and inventory findings. It does not kick, ban or alert others.

npclear.description: Mark a player as reviewed by the new player check
npclear.helpText: Usage: npclear <player>. The player is no longer checked automatically and loses the flag role.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: The player to mark as reviewed

check-on-join.description: Checks a player on their first join on this server (and every join during the watch window).

recheck-pending.description: Retries the check for new players whose inventory was not known yet when they joined.
